title: Kan fibrations are stable under base change

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-kan-base-change at source lines 5926-5931: if f : X to Y is a Kan fibration and Y' to Y is any morphism of simplicial sets, then the base change X times_Y Y' to Y' is again a Kan fibration. The author's proof at source lines 5933-5936 is a single sentence declaring that this follows immediately from the functorial properties of the fibre product and the definitions. As with its trivial-Kan counterpart, the card counts a statement whose proof is a pointer to the carried fibre-product lemma, and the pairing note records that the author supplied no further detail.
